# CG-SCHEMA-901: Composition not analyzable

Composition branches could not be matched reliably.

**Why it matters:** Ambiguous matches would produce unreliable findings.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Schemas](./#schema) |
| Detects | `schema.compositionUnanalyzable` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Composition in {where} could not be analyzed: {reason}.
>
> Branches could not be paired between versions, so branch-level changes are unknown.
>
> **Fix:** Name branches with $ref or title so they can be matched, or review manually.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: ambiguous anonymous branches

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: object, properties: {a: {}}}, {type: string}, {type: boolean}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: object, properties: {a: {}, b: {}}}, {type: object, properties: {a: {}, c: {}}}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, medium. Composition in POST /x: the request body (application/json) could not be analyzed: ambiguous anyOf branch matching.

### Does not fire: branches matched

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: integer}, {type: string, maxLength: 3}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

```yaml

  ignore:
```
